concerns.text: The 'UCI DROP' dataset (ucinlp/drop) is an NLP reading comprehension dataset containing text passages and questions, not a numerical tabular dataset suitable for OLS regression without extensive, non-trivial feature engineering. The plan assumes it provides 'NLP-derived numerical features' directly, which is factually incorrect for the raw dataset. Using this dataset as a primary/secondary source for OLS coefficient stability analysis without a defined, verified numerical transformation pipeline renders the analysis infeasible as described.

The 'UCI HAR' dataset (udayl/UCI_HAR) consists of time-series accelerometer/gyroscope sensor data. It is not a standard tabular dataset for OLS regression. The plan notes it 'may require aggregation' but provides no specific, verified aggregation strategy to convert raw sensor streams into a tabular format with a continuous target variable suitable for OLS. Without this explicit transformation definition, the dataset is inappropriate for the stated OLS stability analysis.
